children: According to ChainCatcher, South Korea’s Finance Ministry said the country is prepared to deploy a market stabilization fund at any time and will ease regulations on stock buybacks to curb market volatility. The government will crack down on illegal stock short selling and closely monitor leveraged investments and margin calls to prevent selling pressure.

title: South Korea Finance Ministry Says Market Stabilization Fund Can Be Deployed at Any Time
